title: A Contested Plan to Protect Prairie Chickens
subtitle: 草原松鸡保护计划：谁来主导，力度多大？
source: 2016 考研英语二 · 阅读理解 Text 2
sourceNote: 依据用户新东方绿皮书PDF物理第40页（印刷2016-6）逐句核对；第41页（2016-7）仅含题目，未纳入正文。英文标题为本工具自拟；译文、例句和解析为AI辅助学习内容，非出版社官方解析。保留原书第8句action后无逗号的写法，学习解析采用与州政府及私人土地所有者合作的回接解读。原书观点按原文保留，不作为现行政策说明。

sentences.text: Biologists estimate that as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens—a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands—once lent red to the often grey landscape of the midwestern and southwestern United States.
sentences.zh: 生物学家估计，曾有多达200万只小草原松鸡——一种生活在绵延草原上的鸟——为美国中西部和西南部常常灰蒙蒙的景色增添红色。
sentences.main: Biologists estimate that prairie chickens once lent red to the landscape.
parts: estimate that ...
that引导宾语从句，估计的内容是这种鸟过去的数量及它们为景色增添的颜色。
as many as 2 million lesser prairie chickens
as many as强调数量多；lesser prairie chicken是鸟名，lesser不能译成“较少的”。
a kind of bird living on stretching grasslands
破折号中的同位语解释鸟名；living是现在分词，修饰bird；stretching形容草原绵延。
once lent red to the often grey landscape
lend ... to ...在这里指给景色增添色彩；once表示过去曾经。

lesser: 鸟名中的“小”，lesser prairie chicken为小草原松鸡
The lesser prairie chicken lives on grasslands.
小草原松鸡生活在草原上。
red: 红色（为景色增添的色彩）
The flowers add red to the garden.
这些花给花园增添了红色。
as: adv. / prep.
as many as中的两个as共同表示“多达”，不能逐词译为“作为”
As many as fifty people came.
来了多达五十人。
that: conj.
引导estimate的宾语从句，说明估计的内容
We estimate that the work will take a week.
我们估计这项工作需要一周。
million: The city has two million residents.
这座城市有两百万居民。
States: United States中的States，与United共同表示美国
The United States is a country.
to: 给；lent red to表示给景色增添红色
The lamps lend warmth to the room.

sentences.text: But just some 22,000 birds remain today, occupying about 16% of the species’ historic range.
sentences.zh: 但如今只剩大约2.2万只，占据的栖息范围约为该物种历史分布范围的16%。
parts: just some 22,000 birds
just突出数量少；some放在数字前表示“大约”，不是“某些”。
occupying about 16% of the species’ historic range
现在分词短语补充剩余鸟群的分布范围；16%指历史分布范围的比例，不是鸟的数量比例。

some: Some thirty students joined the club.
大约三十名学生加入了俱乐部。
range: The species has a small range.
这一物种的分布范围很小。
species’: 这一物种的栖息地正在缩小。
just: 仅仅；只（强调剩余数量少）
about: 班里大约一半的人同意了。
000: 22,000中的千位分组，整组数字表示二万二千

sentences.text: The crash was a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) decided to formally list the bird as threatened.
sentences.zh: 数量骤降是美国鱼类与野生动物管理局（USFWS）决定正式将这种鸟列为“受威胁”物种的重要原因。
sentences.main: The crash was a major reason.
parts: The crash
指上一段所说的鸟类数量骤降，不是碰撞或坠机。
a major reason the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service ... decided ...
reason后接说明原因的从句，相当于a reason why ...；decided的主语是管理局。
to formally list the bird as threatened
list ... as ...表示把……列为……；threatened是本文使用的保护等级，区别于下文endangered。

crash: The crash in sales worried the owner.
service: 机构名称中的管理局：U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service
The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service protects wildlife.
美国鱼类与野生动物管理局保护野生动物。
fish: 鱼类（机构名称的一部分）
threatened: 受威胁的（本文的物种保护等级）
这个公园保护受威胁物种。
list: 把……列入某等级；list ... as把……列为……
They listed the building as historic.
他们把这栋建筑列为历史建筑。
as: prep.
为；作为（引出所列保护等级）
They listed the bird as threatened.
他们把这种鸟列为受威胁物种。

sentences.text: “The lesser prairie chicken is in a desperate situation,” said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe.
sentences.zh: “小草原松鸡的处境十分危急，”USFWS局长丹尼尔·阿什说。
sentences.main: USFWS Director Daniel Ashe said the chicken is in a desperate situation.
parts: is in a desperate situation
in a ... situation表示处于某种境地；desperate在这里指危急、严峻。
said USFWS Director Daniel Ashe
引语后的报道语采用谓语在前、主语在后的语序；Director是职务名称。

lesser: 鸟名中的“小”（小草原松鸡）
The lesser prairie chicken lives on grasslands.
小草原松鸡生活在草原上。
desperate: 危急的；极其严峻的（形容处境）
The village is in a desperate situation.
这个村庄的处境十分危急。

sentences.zh: 不过，一些环保人士对此感到失望。
parts: however
插入的转折副词，转向环保人士对这一保护等级的不同看法。
were disappointed
系表结构，disappointed描述人的失望感受；原因在下一句说明。

disappointed: We were disappointed by the decision.
我们对这个决定感到失望。

sentences.text: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as “endangered”, a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power to crack down on threats.
sentences.zh: 他们此前一直敦促该机构把这种鸟定为“濒危”物种；这一等级会赋予联邦官员更大的监管权力，以严厉打击威胁该物种的行为。
sentences.main: They had pushed the agency to designate the bird as “endangered”.
parts: had pushed the agency to designate ...
过去完成时表示此前已进行的敦促；push ... to do ...在这里不是身体上的推。
a status that gives federal officials greater regulatory power
a status解释“濒危”这一等级；that引导定语从句，作gives的主语。
to crack down on threats
不定式说明监管权力可用于打击威胁；crack down on表示严厉打击或取缔。

pushed: 敦促；施压促使（push的过去分词）
They pushed the school to improve safety.
他们敦促学校改善安全措施。
endangered: 濒危的（本文中比threatened更严格的保护等级）
这个保护区保护濒危鸟类。
that: relative pron.
引导定语从句，指保护等级status，在从句中作主语
We need a rule that protects workers.
我们需要一条保护劳动者的规则。
greater: 更大的（great的比较级，修饰权力）
The new role brings greater responsibility.
新职位带来更大的责任。
They: 他们，指上句中失望的环保人士
他们呼吁更有力的保护。
had: have的过去式，与pushed构成过去完成时，表示此前已经敦促
They had asked for help before we arrived.
我们到达之前他们已请求帮助。
as: prep.
为；作为（designate ... as把……定为……）
They designated the forest as a reserve.
他们把这片森林定为保护区。
power: The agency has power to enforce the rules.
该机构有权执行这些规定。
down: crack down on的一部分，整组表示严厉打击，不作“向下”解释
Police crack down on illegal sales.
警方严厉打击非法销售。
on: crack down on中的介词，引出打击对象
Police crack down on illegal sales.
警方严厉打击非法销售。

sentences.text: But Ashe and others argued that the “threatened” tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
sentences.zh: 但阿什等人认为，“受威胁”这一标签赋予联邦政府灵活性，使其可以尝试新的、可能更少引发对抗的保护方式。
sentences.main: Ashe and others argued that the tag gave the government flexibility.
parts: argued that ...
that引导宾语从句；argued表示提出理由、主张，不一定指争吵。
flexibility to try out new ... conservation approaches
to try out ...补充说明灵活性体现在哪里；try out是尝试使用或试验。
potentially less confrontational
potentially表示可能，并不保证新方式一定减少对抗；less修饰形容词confrontational。

argued: She argued that the plan would save time.
她提出理由说明这个计划能节省时间。
tag: 标签；所给予的保护等级名称
The product carries an eco-friendly tag.
threatened: 受威胁的（物种保护等级）
这个公园保护受威胁物种。
that: conj.
引导宾语从句，说明argued的内容，不单独翻译
She argued that the plan would save time.
她提出理由说明这个计划能节省时间。
out: try out的一部分，整组表示尝试使用、试验
We tried out a new method.
我们试验了一种新方法。
less: 程度较低地；较少地（修饰confrontational）
We need a less confrontational approach.
我们需要一种更少引发对抗的方式。
approaches: We compared two approaches to teaching.
我们比较了两种教学方法。

sentences.text: In particular, they called for forging closer collaborations with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken’s habitat.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，他们呼吁与西部各州政府以及私人土地所有者建立更紧密的合作：州政府常对联邦行动感到不安，而私人土地所有者掌控着估计95%的草原松鸡栖息地。
sentences.main: They called for forging closer collaborations.
parts: called for forging closer collaborations
call for表示呼吁；for是介词，后接动名词forging，forge collaboration指建立合作关系。
with western state governments, which are often uneasy with federal action
which指州政府，补充其对联邦行动的态度；uneasy with表示对……感到不安。
and with the private landowners who control an estimated 95% ...
按两类合作对象解读，and with回接collaborations with；who从句限定私人土地所有者。原书在action后没有逗号，照录，不补入原文。 原标点下也存在回接uneasy with的表面可能；本文按段落语境采用上述读法，并非唯一语法解读。
an estimated 95% of the prairie chicken’s habitat
estimated修饰比例，表示估计值；95%是栖息地比例。

they: 他们，指阿什及持相同立场的人
他们提出了一个新计划。
with: 与……（合作对象）；对……（uneasy with的对象）
We work with people who are uneasy with change.
我们与那些对变化感到不安的人合作。
state: The state government approved the plan.
州政府批准了这个计划。
closer: 更紧密的（close的比较级，修饰合作）
两个团队建立了更紧密的联系。
forging: The project is forging new partnerships.
这个项目正在建立新的合作关系。
estimated: The estimated cost is fifty dollars.
chicken’s: 这只松鸡的栖息地受到保护。
called: call的过去式；called for表示呼吁、要求
They called for better public transport.
他们呼吁改善公共交通。
for: call for中的介词，引出呼吁的内容
which: 引导补充性定语从句，指western state governments，作从句主语
The teams, which need support, will meet today.
这些需要支持的团队今天将开会。
who: 引导定语从句，指私人土地所有者，作control的主语
Owners who protect the land can receive help.
保护土地的所有者可以获得帮助。
private: 私人的；私有的（形容土地所有者）
私人土地所有者管理这片森林。

sentences.text: Under the plan, for example, the agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird, as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan to restore prairie chicken habitat.
sentences.zh: 例如，该机构表示，按这项计划，只要土地所有者或企业已签署一项覆盖该物种整个分布区域、旨在恢复草原松鸡栖息地的管理计划，就不会因无意中杀死、伤害或惊扰这种鸟而被起诉。
sentences.main: The agency said it would not prosecute landowners or businesses.
parts: it would not prosecute ...
it指该机构；would与过去的said呼应。not是否定起诉，不能漏译。
that unintentionally kill, harm, or disturb the bird
that引导定语从句，限定土地所有者或企业；unintentionally修饰并列的三个动词。
as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan
as long as表示条件“只要”；they指土地所有者或企业；range-wide为覆盖整个分布区域。
to restore prairie chicken habitat
不定式说明管理计划的目的，不表示已经完成恢复。

under: Under the rules, visitors must sign in.
it: pron.
它，指前面的agency，即该机构
The agency said it would investigate.
该机构表示将进行调查。
that: relative pron.
引导定语从句，指landowners or businesses，在从句中作主语
Companies that pollute must pay.
造成污染的公司必须缴费。
as: conj. (phrase)
as long as中两个as共同构成条件连接语“只要”
You can stay as long as you are quiet.
只要你保持安静，就可以留下。
would: 在过去的said之后表示将会（过去将来），不是假设条件
The agency said it would investigate.
该机构表示将进行调查。
for: for example中的介词，整组表示例如
For example, you can walk to work.
long: as long as的一部分，此处整组表示条件“只要”，不是时间长短
You can stay as long as you are quiet.
只要你保持安静，就可以留下。
they: 他们，指土地所有者或企业
had: 与signed构成过去完成时，表示签署在前
They had signed the agreement before work began.
工作开始之前他们已经签署了协议。
businesses: 小企业创造本地就业机会。

sentences.text: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
sentences.zh: 这项由USFWS与各州协商制定的计划要求：个人和企业如果在经营活动中破坏栖息地，就要向一项基金缴款，用两英亩新的适宜栖息地替代每一英亩被毁的栖息地。
sentences.main: The plan requires individuals and businesses to pay into a fund.
parts: Negotiated by USFWS and the states
过去分词短语修饰主语the plan，表示计划由双方协商制定，不是个人和企业被协商。
requires individuals and businesses ... to pay into a fund
require ... to do ...表示要求……做……；that damage ...限定要缴款的对象。
as part of their operations
指作为其经营活动的一部分；operations是经营或业务活动，不是手术。
to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat
to replace说明基金用途；destroyed修饰acre，表示被毁的一英亩；replace A with B意为用B替代A，比例是一比二。

operations: 经营活动；业务运作（operation的复数）
这家公司调整了经营活动。
that: relative pron.
引导定语从句，指会破坏栖息地的个人与企业
Businesses that cause damage must pay.
造成损害的企业必须缴费。
as: prep.
作为（as part of：作为……的一部分）
I write notes as part of my study routine.
写笔记是我学习日常的一部分。
destroyed: 被毁的（destroy的过去分词，修饰acre）
businesses: 小企业创造本地就业机会。
individuals: 个人可以加入这项计划。
fund: 基金；用于某项用途的一笔资金
这项基金支持本地项目。
with: 用……（replace A with B：用B替换A）
Replace the broken chair with a new one.
用一把新椅子替换坏椅子。
replace: 替换；用新栖息地替代被毁栖息地
Replace the broken chair with a new one.
用一把新椅子替换坏椅子。
into: 向……里面（pay into a fund：向基金缴款）
Each member pays into the fund.
每位成员都向基金缴款。

sentences.text: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
sentences.zh: 这项基金还将用于补偿那些留出土地作为栖息地的土地所有者。
sentences.main: The fund will be used to compensate landowners.
parts: will also be used to compensate
将来时的被动结构；be used to do表示被用来做某事，区别于be used to doing“习惯于”。
landowners who set aside habitat
who从句限定获得补偿的土地所有者；set aside在这里指留出、划拨土地，不是暂时不考虑某事。

used: 被使用；be used to do表示被用来做……
The money will be used to repair the roof.
这笔钱将被用来修屋顶。
fund: 基金；用于某项用途的一笔资金
这项基金支持本地项目。
who: 引导定语从句，指留出栖息地的土地所有者，作set aside的主语
Owners who set aside land can get help.
留出土地的所有者可以获得帮助。
set: set aside中的动词，整组表示预留、留出
We set aside a room for study.
我们留出一间房用于学习。

sentences.text: USFWS also set an interim goal of restoring prairie chicken populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds over the next 10 years.
sentences.zh: USFWS还设定了一项阶段性目标：在未来10年内，将草原松鸡的种群数量恢复到年均6.7万只的水平。
parts: an interim goal of restoring ...
of后的动名词短语说明目标内容；interim表示阶段性、暂定的，不是最终承诺。
populations to an annual average of 67,000 birds
restore ... to ...意为恢复到某个水平；annual average是年均数量，不是每年新增6.7万只。
over the next 10 years
指未来十年这一时段；原文用平均值描述目标，不应额外断言每年的最低数量。

set: 他们设定了一个明确目标。
over: Sales grew over the next two years.
销售额在接下来的两年里增长了。
000: 67,000中的千位分组，整组数字表示六万七千
average: 平均值；an annual average表示年均数量
The annual average is one hundred visitors.
年均访客数量为一百人。

sentences.text: And it gives the Western Association of Fish and Wildlife Agencies (WAFWA), a coalition of state agencies, the job of monitoring progress.
sentences.zh: 该计划还把监测进展的任务交给了西部鱼类与野生动物机构协会（WAFWA），这是一个由各州机构组成的联盟。
sentences.main: It gives WAFWA the job of monitoring progress.
parts: it gives ... the job ...
it指该计划；give后接两个宾语，先是任务接收者，再是任务内容。
a coalition of state agencies
同位语说明WAFWA是什么组织；state agencies指各州的机构。
the job of monitoring progress
of后的动名词短语说明job的内容；monitor是持续监测，而非保证目标达成。

it: pron.
它，指该计划
The plan is detailed, and it gives everyone a task.
这个计划很详细，还给每个人安排了任务。
job: Her job is to monitor progress.
state: 州级机构共同开展工作。
fish: 鱼类（机构名称的一部分）
coalition: 联盟；这里指州级机构组成的联合组织
几个团体组成了一个联盟。

sentences.text: Overall, the idea is to let “states remain in the driver’s seat for managing the species,” Ashe said.
sentences.zh: 阿什说，总体思路是让“各州继续主导这一物种的管理”。
sentences.main: The idea is to let states remain in the driver’s seat.
parts: the idea is to let ...
不定式作表语，说明总体思路；let后接宾语加不带to的动词原形remain。
remain in the driver’s seat for managing the species
in the driver’s seat是比喻“掌握主导权”，不是实际坐在驾驶座；for managing说明主导的是物种管理。
Ashe said
报道语放在句末；引语末尾逗号保留原书形式。

states: 各州，作为物种管理的主导者
各州可以管理本地保护区。
driver’s: 驾驶者的；in the driver’s seat比喻处于主导地位
She is in the driver’s seat on this project.
她在这个项目中掌握主导权。
remain: 继续处于；保持（主导地位）
She remains in charge of the team.
seat: 座位；in the driver’s seat整组比喻掌握主导权
She is in the driver’s seat on this project.
她在这个项目中掌握主导权。
for: 在……方面；引出负责管理的事项
She has responsibility for managing the team.
她承担管理团队的责任。

goes: go的第三人称单数；go too far表示做得过头、超过合理限度

go: 达到某种程度；doesn’t go far enough表示保护力度不足

这项改革的力度还不够。

burnable.example: Keep burnable material away from heat.

alone.meaning: 仅；单是，强调2016这一个年份，不是孤独地。
alone.example: We planted 200 trees this year alone.
alone.exampleZh: 仅今年我们就种了200棵树。

burn.example: The fire has burned several fields.
burn.exampleZh: 这场火已经烧毁了几块田地。

hundred.meaning: 百；hundreds of表示数百，hundreds of thousands表示数十万
hundred.example: Hundreds of thousands of people live here.

finance.example: The project is financed by donations.

proceeds.meaning: 收入；收益，在本句不是proceed的动词变形。
proceeds.example: The proceeds of the sale support the school.
proceeds.exampleZh: 出售所得支持这所学校。

emissions-permit.meaning: 排放许可；修饰auctions，指排放许可拍卖。
emissions-permit.exampleZh: 排放许可拍卖筹集公共资金。

auction.example: The auctions raised money for repairs.
auction.exampleZh: 这些拍卖筹集了修理资金。

acreage.meaning: 以英亩计的面积；总占地面积。
acreage.exampleZh: 这一面积包含几片森林。

area.exampleZh: 某些地区面临更大的风险。

ensure.example: We must ensure that the water is clean.
ensure.exampleZh: 我们必须确保水是干净的。

remove.example: The wood removed from the site was reused.
remove.exampleZh: 从现场移除的木材被再次利用。

lock.example: The records are locked away safely.

form.meaning: 形式；in the form of表示以……的形式。
form.example: The payment came in the form of a cheque.

solid.meaning: 实心的；实体的，修饰lumber这一木材产品。
solid.example: The table is made of solid wood.

lumber.meaning: 木材；锯成可供使用的木材。
lumber.example: The lumber is used to build houses.
lumber.exampleZh: 这些木材用于建造房屋。

biofuel.meaning: 生物燃料；由生物质材料制成的燃料。
biofuel.example: The vehicle can run on biofuel.
biofuel.exampleZh: 这辆车可以使用生物燃料运行。

otherwise.meaning: 否则；若不用上述生物燃料的话。
otherwise.example: Use biofuel; otherwise the engine runs on petrol.
otherwise.exampleZh: 使用生物燃料；否则发动机使用汽油运行。

transportation.meaning: 交通运输；修饰biofuels，说明用途。

accustomed.meaning: 习惯的；熟悉的，be accustomed to后接名词或动名词。
accustomed.example: They are accustomed to managing risks.

traditionally.example: Traditionally, the area was used for farming.
traditionally.exampleZh: 传统上，这个地区用于农业。

they've.meaning: they have的缩写；they指州政府，have与focused构成现在完成时。

recreation.example: The area is open for recreation.
recreation.exampleZh: 这个地区开放用于休闲活动。

expect.example: The work is expected to finish soon.
expect.exampleZh: 这项工作预计很快完成。

finalize.example: The agreement will be finalized soon.

model.example: The school became a model for others.
model.exampleZh: 这所学校成为其他学校的范例。

complain.meaning: complain的现在分词；在complain of中表示抱怨
complain.example: They have been complaining of delays.

overhaul.exampleZh: 这个系统需要全面改革。

immigration.meaning: 移民；本文修饰规则或执法行动
immigration.exampleZh: 移民规定影响外国工人。

straightforward.meaning: 简单直接的；容易理解或办理的

visa.example: She applied for a work visa.

foreign.example: Foreign workers help with the harvest.
foreign.exampleZh: 外国工人帮助收获作物。

loser.meaning: 受损者；在利益得失中吃亏的一方
loser.example: Small firms may be the losers.
loser.exampleZh: 小企业可能成为受损的一方。

laborer.meaning: 劳工；体力劳动者，laborer的复数
laborer.exampleZh: 农场劳工工作时间很长。

undocumented.meaning: 无合法移民身份文件的；并非普通的未记录
undocumented.exampleZh: 无合法身份文件的工人可能避开官员。

characteristic.exampleZh: 劳动力群体的特点正在变化。

workforce.meaning: 劳动力群体；全体从业人员
workforce.exampleZh: 劳动力群体的年龄正在上升。

predominantly.exampleZh: 劳动力群体主要由本地人组成。

bear.meaning: bear的过去分词；be born表示出生

mexico.example: The company moved production to Mexico.
mexico.exampleZh: 公司把生产转移到墨西哥。

settled.meaning: 已定居的；生活稳定在一地的
settled.example: The workers are settled in one town.
settled.exampleZh: 这些工人已在一个城镇定居。

migrate.meaning: migrate的现在分词；为工作等流动迁移
migrate.example: The workers are migrating for seasonal jobs.
migrate.exampleZh: 这些工人在为季节性工作迁移。

single.example: Some of the workers are single.

crop.meaning: 作物；这里修饰workers，指种植或采收作物的劳工
crop.example: Crop workers need shade and water.
crop.exampleZh: 作物种植劳工需要遮阴和饮水。

oft-debated.meaning: 经常被讨论的；oft是often的文语形式
oft-debated.exampleZh: 这是一个经常被讨论的问题。

cure.meaning: 解决办法；对社会问题使用的比喻义
cure.example: There is no simple cure for the shortage.
cure.exampleZh: 没有简单办法能解决短缺。

implausible.meaning: 不可信的；不切实际的，此处评价解决方案
implausible.exampleZh: 提出的解决方案似乎不切实际。

native.example: Native workers may choose other jobs.
native.exampleZh: 本土工人可能选择其他工作。

mechanization.meaning: 机械化；用机械替代或减少人工劳动
mechanization.example: Mechanization can reduce the need for labor.
mechanization.exampleZh: 机械化可以减少对人力的需求。

cotton.example: Cotton needs a warm growing season.
cotton.exampleZh: 棉花需要温暖的生长季。

rice.meaning: 稻米；水稻，本文按种植语境指水稻

mechanize.meaning: mechanize的过去分词；使机械化，本文为被动
mechanize.example: The production process has been mechanized.
mechanize.exampleZh: 生产过程已经实现机械化。

high-value.example: High-value crops can bring more income.
high-value.exampleZh: 高价值作物可以带来更多收入。

labor-intensive.meaning: 劳动密集型的；需要大量人力的
labor-intensive.exampleZh: 采摘水果需要大量人力。

dairy.meaning: 乳制品生产的；dairy farms指奶牛场

robot.example: Robots do some of the work.
robot.exampleZh: 机器人承担了一部分工作。

milk.meaning: 独立不可数名词，表示挤奶活动；robots do a small share of milking指机器人承担一小部分挤奶工作
milk.example: Robots now do some of the milking.
milk.exampleZh: 现在机器人承担部分挤奶工作。

automate.meaning: automate的过去分词；使自动化，本文为被动

reliant.meaning: 依赖的；reliant on后接所依赖的人或事物
reliant.example: The town is reliant on farming.

temporary.example: They hired temporary workers for the harvest.
temporary.exampleZh: 他们为收获季雇用了临时工。

guest.meaning: 外来的；在guest workers中指获准暂时入境工作的劳工
guest.example: Guest workers help during the harvest.
guest.exampleZh: 外来劳工在收获期间帮忙。

h.meaning: H-2A签证编号中的字母H；当前按片段点击，不按普通单词处理。
h.example: The H-2A visa is for agricultural work.

request.meaning: 请求；申请，此处指签证申请

numerical.meaning: 数量上的；用数字表示的
numerical.example: The program has a numerical cap.

b.meaning: H-2B签证编号中的末尾字母B；不作为普通单词
b.example: The H-2B visa is for nonagricultural work.

nonagricultural.example: The visa is for nonagricultural work.
nonagricultural.exampleZh: 这种签证用于非农业工作。

cumbersome.meaning: 繁琐的；手续复杂不便的

expensive.example: The process is expensive for small firms.
expensive.exampleZh: 这个程序对小企业来说费用很高。

bureaucratic.meaning: 官僚程序的；官僚作风的
bureaucratic.exampleZh: 官僚程序造成的延误拖慢了流程。

delay.exampleZh: 这些延误造成了严重问题。

arrive.example: The workers arrived on the job late.

compound.meaning: compound的过去分词；加剧，使问题更严重
compound.example: The shortage was compounded by delays.

raid.meaning: 突查；突袭式执法行动，raid的复数
raid.example: The raids removed some workers from the farms.
raid.exampleZh: 这些突查带走了农场中的一些工人。

underground.meaning: 秘密地；隐匿起来，本文为比喻义
underground.example: The threats drove the group underground.
underground.exampleZh: 威胁迫使这个群体转入隐匿状态。

tree-fruit.meaning: 树生水果；这里修饰growers，指树上结果的果树作物
tree-fruit.exampleZh: 树生水果种植户需要季节性工人。

grower.example: Fruit growers need workers at harvest time.
grower.exampleZh: 水果种植户在收获时需要工人。

raisin.meaning: 葡萄干；raisin growers按原文指用于生产葡萄干的种植户
raisin.exampleZh: 葡萄干生产需要合适的葡萄。

berry.exampleZh: 浆果种植户用手工收获。

fruit.meaning: 水果；本文为不可数集合用法
fruit.example: Most of the fruit was grown locally.
fruit.exampleZh: 大多数水果是在本地种植的。

import.meaning: import的过去分词；进口，本文为被动

food.meaning: 食物；本文指需要采收的农产品

arnold.meaning: Arnold，人名阿诺德；与Schwarzenegger组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。
arnold.exampleZh: 阿诺德加入了这个小组。

schwarzenegger.meaning: Schwarzenegger，姓氏施瓦辛格；与Arnold组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。
schwarzenegger.exampleZh: 施瓦辛格出现在视频中。

dia.meaning: Dia，人名迪雅；与Mirza组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。

mirza.meaning: Mirza，姓氏米尔扎；与Dia组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。
mirza.exampleZh: 米尔扎传达了一条信息。

adrian.meaning: Adrian，人名阿德里安；与Grenier组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。
adrian.exampleZh: 阿德里安制作了一段短视频。

grenier.meaning: Grenier，姓氏格雷尼尔；与Adrian组成同一人名，未提供专名读音。
grenier.exampleZh: 格雷尼尔支持了这项宣传活动。

beat.meaning: 战胜、克服；beat plastic在本句指克服塑料污染问题。
beat.example: We can beat this problem together.
beat.exampleZh: 我们可以一起克服这个问题。

plastic.meaning: 塑料；beat plastic按环保宣传语理解为克服塑料污染问题。
plastic.example: We can reduce the use of plastic.
plastic.exampleZh: 我们可以减少塑料使用。

bunch.meaning: 一群、一批；a bunch of在这里指一群人，较口语。
bunch.example: A bunch of friends came to help.

celebrity.exampleZh: 几位名人支持了这项宣传活动。

star.meaning: star的现在分词；出演、担任主要角色，修饰celebrities。
star.example: The actors starring in the video are volunteers.
star.exampleZh: 出演这段视频的演员都是志愿者。

video.example: The video explains the problem clearly.
video.exampleZh: 这个视频把问题解释得很清楚。

swap.example: You can swap out that old bottle.
swap.exampleZh: 你可以把那个旧瓶子换掉。

single-use.exampleZh: 一次性杯子会产生垃圾。

staple.meaning: staple的复数；这里指日常常用或必需物品，不是订书钉。
staple.example: Rice and beans are staples in many homes.
staple.exampleZh: 米和豆类是许多家庭的常备食品。

crisis.meaning: 危机；这里指塑料污染带来的环境危机。
crisis.example: The city is facing a waste crisis.
crisis.exampleZh: 这座城市正面临垃圾处理危机。

enact.meaning: 制定、通过法律；通常用于法律或立法。
enact.example: The government enacted a new law.
enact.exampleZh: 政府通过了一项新法律。

legislation.meaning: 立法、法律法规；不可数名词。
legislation.example: New legislation will limit plastic waste.
legislation.exampleZh: 新的法律将限制塑料废弃物。

curb.example: The law aims to curb waste.
curb.exampleZh: 这项法律旨在遏制浪费。

overarching.meaning: 总体的、统领全局的；修饰message，是独立形容词。
overarching.example: The report has one overarching aim.
overarching.exampleZh: 这份报告有一个总体目标。

direct.meaning: direct的过去分词；be directed at表示以某人为对象、面向某人。
direct.example: The message is directed at young people.

bag.exampleZh: 可重复使用的袋子能减少垃圾。

quit.meaning: quit的动名词；停止使用、放弃，宾语是塑料吸管。
quit.example: Quitting single-use straws is a small step.
quit.exampleZh: 停止使用一次性吸管是一小步。

straw.meaning: straw的复数；饮料吸管，不是稻草。
straw.example: The cafe no longer uses plastic straws.
straw.exampleZh: 这家咖啡馆不再使用塑料吸管。

accomplish.example: The first step accomplished very little.
accomplish.exampleZh: 第一步取得的成果很少。

satisfy.meaning: satisfy的现在分词；满足某种心理需求，不是形容词“令人满意的”。
satisfy.example: The activity helps others, satisfying a need to feel useful.
satisfy.exampleZh: 这项活动帮助别人，也满足了感到自己有用的需求。

bit.meaning: 一小部分；do one’s bit整体为尽自己的一份力，不是数据单位。
bit.exampleZh: 每个人都可以尽自己的一份力。

onto.meaning: 向、到；progressing onto在这里表示进一步走向更大行动。
onto.example: The discussion moved onto a wider issue.
onto.exampleZh: 讨论转向了一个更广泛的问题。

bold.meaning: bold的比较级；更大胆、更有力度的，修饰actions。
bold.exampleZh: 这座城市需要更大胆的行动。

licensing.meaning: 许可；moral licensing在这里是独立名词性的心理概念，不是政府发放许可证的动作。
licensing.example: Moral licensing can weaken later efforts.
licensing.exampleZh: 道德许可心理可能削弱后续努力。

ease.meaning: ease的第三人称单数；减轻、缓解。
ease.exampleZh: 这个消息缓解了他们的担忧。

charge.meaning: 主管、负责的状态；in charge表示掌权或负责，不是收费。
charge.example: The person in charge approved the plan.
charge.exampleZh: 负责人批准了这项计划。

shopping.meaning: 购物；shopping bags整体指购物袋，这里不表示正在购物。
shopping.exampleZh: 可重复使用的购物袋更耐用。

ignore.meaning: ignore的现在分词；忽视，we’re ignoring为现在进行时。
ignore.example: We are ignoring a larger problem.
ignore.exampleZh: 我们正在忽视一个更大的问题。

imply.meaning: imply的第三人称单数；意味着、暗示。
imply.example: The rule implies that individuals must pay.
imply.exampleZh: 这项规则意味着个人必须付费。

sustainably.meaning: 以可持续的方式；修饰shop，是独立副词。
sustainably.example: The family tries to live sustainably.
sustainably.exampleZh: 这家人努力以可持续的方式生活。

citizen.meaning: citizen的复数；公民，强调问责和公共参与的身份。
citizen.example: Citizens can ask for policy changes.
citizen.exampleZh: 公民可以要求改变政策。

systemic.meaning: 系统性的、涉及整个体系的；不同于systematic“有条理的”。
systemic.exampleZh: 这个问题需要系统性变革。

r.meaning: 姓名Elizabeth R. DeSombre中的中间名首字母R.；当前分词器仅识别R，保留原句句点，不提供普通字母词义或音标。
r.example: The author is named Elizabeth R. DeSombre.
r.exampleZh: 作者名叫伊丽莎白·R. 德桑布尔。

desombre.meaning: DeSombre，作者姓氏德桑布尔；专名读音待核对。
desombre.exampleZh: 德桑布尔讨论环保行为。

best.example: This is the best way to reduce waste.
best.exampleZh: 这是减少垃圾的最佳办法。

collectively.meaning: 共同地、作为整体地；修饰change，是独立副词。
collectively.example: We can act collectively to change the rules.
collectively.exampleZh: 我们可以共同行动来改变规则。

behavior.meaning: 行为；美式拼写，原书照录。

structural.meaning: 结构性的；这里涉及制度、规则、激励等层面的改变。
structural.exampleZh: 这个系统需要结构性改革。

implement.example: Implementing the policy will take time.
implement.exampleZh: 落实这项政策需要时间。

environmentally.meaning: 在环境方面；修饰problematic，是独立副词。
environmentally.exampleZh: 这个过程在环境方面有害。

problematic.meaning: 有问题的、会造成困难的；这里指有损环境的行为。
problematic.example: Wasteful habits can be environmentally problematic.
problematic.exampleZh: 浪费的习惯可能造成环境问题。

ban.meaning: ban的动名词；禁止，作为mean的并列宾语。
ban.example: Banning single-use cups would reduce waste.
ban.exampleZh: 禁止一次性杯子会减少垃圾。

altogether.meaning: 完全、彻底；修饰banning，不是总计。
altogether.example: The rule bans these bags altogether.
altogether.exampleZh: 这条规则彻底禁用了这些袋子。

india.meaning: India，印度；本文中的政策声明是原报道时点的信息。
india.exampleZh: 印度宣布了一项新计划。

eliminate.example: The plan aims to eliminate unnecessary waste.
eliminate.exampleZh: 这项计划旨在消除不必要的浪费。

incentive-based.meaning: 基于激励措施的；修饰ways，复合词音标待核对。
incentive-based.example: An incentive-based policy rewards useful changes.
incentive-based.exampleZh: 基于激励的政策会奖励有益的改变。

recycling.meaning: 回收利用；独立名词，在从句中作主语，不表示现在进行时。

trash.meaning: 垃圾；trash disposal整体为垃圾丢弃、处理。

disposal.meaning: 丢弃、处理；trash disposal指处理垃圾。

none.meaning: 没有任何一个、没有任何部分；none of this否定对前文讨论的误读。
none.example: None of this means we should stop trying.
none.exampleZh: 这些都不意味着我们应该停止努力。

progressive.meaning: 进步的、推动改进的；作者对所需政策的评价。
progressive.exampleZh: 进步政策可以支持改革。

shape.meaning: 塑造、引导；是动词，不是形状名词。

collective.example: Collective action can change a system.
collective.exampleZh: 集体行动可以改变一个系统。

alongside.meaning: 与……并行、同时有……；说明政策与积极参与的公民共同发挥作用。
alongside.exampleZh: 政策与公众行动共同发挥作用。

engaged.meaning: 积极参与的、投入其中的；修饰citizens，不是订婚或占线。
engaged.exampleZh: 积极参与的公民可以影响政策。

rat.meaning: 大鼠；本文指用于实验的动物。
rat.exampleZh: 这只大鼠按压了一根杠杆。

attuned.meaning: 敏感的；be attuned to表示能敏锐察觉并回应。
attuned.example: She is attuned to changes in tone.
attuned.exampleZh: 她对语气的变化很敏感。

signal.meaning: 信号；传递信息或提示的迹象。
signal.example: The light is a warning signal.
signal.exampleZh: 这盏灯是一个警告信号。

cooperate.exampleZh: 我们与另一支团队合作。

avoid.example: We should avoid that dangerous road.
avoid.exampleZh: 我们应避开那条危险的路。

non-living.example: A stone is a non-living object.

laleh.meaning: Laleh，人名拉蕾；未提供专名读音。

quinn.meaning: Quinn，姓氏奎因；本文研究者的姓氏。

san.meaning: San，San Diego地名的一部分，不能单独按普通词解释。

have an impact on.exampleZh: 小改变也能影响你的健康。

be down to.example: The final decision is down to you.

in the short term.example: This may save money in the short term.

face up to.meaning: 正视并着手应对（困难或事实）
face up to.example: We need to face up to the problem.
face up to.exampleZh: 我们需要正视这个问题。

be set to.example: The shop is set to open next month.
be set to.exampleZh: 这家店定于下个月开业。

return to power.example: The party hopes to return to power.

adjust to.example: It takes time to adjust to a new routine.
adjust to.exampleZh: 适应新的日常安排需要时间。

go away.example: The problem will not go away by itself.

contrary to.example: Contrary to my expectations, I enjoyed it.
contrary to.exampleZh: 出乎我的预料，我很喜欢它。

be supposed to.meaning: 应该；按常理被认为应当
be supposed to.example: Home is supposed to be a place to relax.

conventional wisdom.meaning: 普遍接受的看法；传统观念
conventional wisdom.exampleZh: 她的经历挑战了普遍看法。

as well as.example: We need patience as well as practice.
as well as.exampleZh: 我们既需要练习，也需要耐心。

hold true.example: This rule holds true for beginners too.
hold true.exampleZh: 这条规则对初学者也适用。

kick back.example: I just want to kick back and read.
kick back.exampleZh: 我只想放松一下，看看书。

get to do something.meaning: 有机会做某事；能够享受到做某事
get to do something.example: I finally get to take a break.
get to do something.exampleZh: 我终于有机会休息一下了。

play catch-up.meaning: 努力赶上；补做落下的事情；原句为 playing catch-up-with-household tasks
play catch-up.example: I'm playing catch-up with my emails.
play catch-up.exampleZh: 我正赶着处理积下来的邮件。

lag behind.example: Our progress lags behind the plan.
lag behind.exampleZh: 我们的进度落后于计划。

make adjustments.meaning: 作出调整；原句 making adjustments
make adjustments.example: We made adjustments to our routine.

pretty much.example: I pretty much understand it now.

in order to.example: I left early in order to avoid traffic.
in order to.exampleZh: 我早早出发以避开拥堵。

put in.meaning: 投入（时间、精力或劳动）；原句 puts in hours
put in.example: She put in two hours of practice.
put in.exampleZh: 她投入了两个小时练习。

on the home front.meaning: 在家庭这一边；家庭生活方面（比喻用法）
on the home front.example: Things are busy on the home front.

division of labor.example: We agreed on a clear division of labor.
division of labor.exampleZh: 我们商定了明确的分工。

lay out.meaning: 清楚地说明、安排或规划；原句 laid out 为被动式
lay out.example: She laid out a plan for the week.
lay out.exampleZh: 她清楚地列出了一周计划。

talk someone into something.meaning: 说服某人做某事；into 后接名词或动名词；原句 be talked into it
talk someone into something.example: She talked me into trying again.

threaten someone with something.meaning: 以某事威胁某人；原句为 threatened with … 的被动式
threaten someone with something.example: They threatened us with legal action.
threaten someone with something.exampleZh: 他们威胁要对我们采取法律行动。

not only … (but also) ….meaning: 不仅……而且……；not only 在句首时其分句倒装，原句省略 but also
not only … (but also) ….example: Not only is it cheap, but it is also useful.

a range of.example: The library offers a range of resources.

dropout rate.meaning: 辍学率；原句 dropout rates 为复数
dropout rate.example: The school hopes to lower its dropout rate.

succeed in.meaning: 在……方面成功；成功做某事，in 后接名词或动名词
succeed in.example: She succeeded in finding a new job.

in that.meaning: 因为；在于（解释原因或某方面）
in that.example: This plan is useful in that it saves time.
in that.exampleZh: 这个计划有用，因为它节省时间。

achievement gap.meaning: 学业成就差距；学习表现上的差距
achievement gap.example: Extra support can narrow the achievement gap.
achievement gap.exampleZh: 额外支持有助于缩小学业成就差距。

next to no.meaning: 几乎没有；原句复合形容词 next-to-no-cost 意为成本极低
next to no.example: The change took next to no time.
next to no.exampleZh: 这个改动几乎没花时间。

be based on.meaning: 以……为依据；建立在……基础上
be based on.example: The lesson is based on a true story.
be based on.exampleZh: 这堂课以一个真实故事为基础。

be defined as.example: Success can be defined as steady progress.
be defined as.exampleZh: 成功可以被定义为稳步进步。

not … but ….meaning: 不是……而是……；原句 not in potential but in practical knowledge
not … but ….example: I need not more time but a simpler plan.
not … but ….exampleZh: 我需要的不是更多时间，而是更简单的计划。

deal with.example: Let's deal with one problem at a time.
deal with.exampleZh: 我们一次处理一个问题吧。

struggle to.meaning: 艰难地努力做；做某事有困难
struggle to.example: I struggle to remember long lists.
struggle to.exampleZh: 我很难记住长长的清单。

rules of the game.meaning: 游戏规则；比喻某环境中的惯例和运作规则
rules of the game.example: A new employee needs to learn the rules of the game.
rules of the game.exampleZh: 新员工需要了解这里的运作规则。

take advantage of.meaning: 利用（机会或资源）；此处不含占便宜的贬义
take advantage of.example: Take advantage of the free classes.

more of a.meaning: 更算是……；更构成……；原句 more of a problem
more of a.example: It's more of a challenge than I expected.
more of a.exampleZh: 它比我预想的更有挑战性。

lingua franca.meaning: 通用语；本文比喻企业界共同使用的表达方式
lingua franca.example: English is the team's lingua franca.
lingua franca.exampleZh: 英语是这个团队的通用语。

spin off.meaning: 衍生；接连产生；原句 spinning off examples 为接连举例
spin off.example: The discussion spun off several new ideas.
spin off.exampleZh: 讨论衍生出了几个新想法。

by coincidence.meaning: 碰巧；出于巧合；原句 not by coincidence 表示并非巧合
by coincidence.example: We chose the same book by coincidence.
by coincidence.exampleZh: 我们碰巧选了同一本书。

a big deal.meaning: 重要的事；很了不起的事（口语）
a big deal.example: Finishing my first article was a big deal for me.
a big deal.exampleZh: 读完第一篇文章对我来说是一件大事。

be in this together.meaning: 共同面对同一处境；一起承担；原句 we're in this together
be in this together.example: Don't worry. We're in this together.

think of … as ….meaning: 把……看作……；原句 think of themselves as coaches
think of … as ….example: I think of reading as a break.
think of … as ….exampleZh: 我把阅读看作一种休息。

be intended to.meaning: 旨在；目的是……；原句 are intended to
be intended to.example: The notes are intended to help beginners.
be intended to.exampleZh: 这些笔记旨在帮助初学者。

infuse … with ….example: She infused the lesson with energy.

used to.meaning: 过去常常；过去曾处于某状态，后接动词原形
used to.example: I used to be afraid of long sentences.

be associated with.example: The color is associated with calm.
be associated with.exampleZh: 这种颜色常让人联想到平静。

work-life balance.exampleZh: 我希望更好地平衡工作与生活。

have it all.meaning: 同时拥有所有理想的东西；本文指兼顾事业与家庭
have it all.example: She wants a career and time with her family, but it's hard to have it all.
have it all.exampleZh: 她既想拥有事业，也想有时间陪家人，但两全很难。

in its own right.meaning: 凭其本身；本身就具有某种地位或价值
in its own right.example: The town is worth visiting in its own right.
in its own right.exampleZh: 这座小镇本身就值得一游。

set boundaries.meaning: 设定界限；原句 setting boundaries
set boundaries.example: I set boundaries around my work time.
set boundaries.exampleZh: 我为自己的工作时间划定界限。

devote oneself to.meaning: 全身心投入；致力于；原句 devote yourself to it，to 后接名词或动名词

even if.example: I'll read one sentence even if I'm busy.
even if.exampleZh: 即使很忙，我也会读一句。

office speak.meaning: 职场话语；办公室常用的管理术语和套话
office speak.example: The report is full of office speak.
office speak.exampleZh: 这份报告充满职场套话。

make fun of.meaning: 取笑；拿……开玩笑；原句 makes fun of

depend on.exampleZh: 我们的计划依靠团队合作。

buy into.meaning: 接受；认同或相信（某种观念、说法），非实际购买
buy into.example: I don't buy into that idea.

be indifferent to.meaning: 对……漠不关心；原句 that's … indifferent to
be indifferent to.example: He is indifferent to public opinion.

figure out.example: I finally figured out the meaning.

relate to.meaning: 与……有联系；涉及；本文为理解自己与工作的关系
relate to.example: The course helps you explore how you relate to your work.
relate to.exampleZh: 这门课帮助你探索自己与工作的关系。

along with.example: Bring a notebook along with your textbook.
along with.exampleZh: 带上课本，也带上笔记本。

at a … pace.meaning: 以……的速度；原文 at a decent pace / at a faster pace
at a … pace.example: The project is advancing at a steady pace.
at a … pace.exampleZh: 项目正以稳定的速度推进。

have a long way to go.key: have a long way to go
have a long way to go.meaning: 还有很长的路要走；离目标还远
have a long way to go.example: We have a long way to go before the work is finished.
have a long way to go.exampleZh: 要完成这项工作，我们还有很长的路要走。

the number of.meaning: ……的数量；中心词 number 通常按单数处理
the number of.example: The number of visitors is rising.

be worth doing.meaning: 值得做某事；原句 is worth making，worth 后接动名词

have a hard time doing.meaning: 做某事很困难；原文 having a very hard time making …
have a hard time doing.example: I had a hard time finding the address.
have a hard time doing.exampleZh: 我费了很大劲才找到那个地址。

make ends meet.meaning: 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；原文 making ends meet
make ends meet.example: They took extra work to make ends meet.
make ends meet.exampleZh: 他们额外接活以维持生计。

the difference between … and ….example: Can you explain the difference between price and value?
the difference between … and ….exampleZh: 你能解释价格与价值之间的区别吗？

be classified as.meaning: 被归类为；原句 are classified as
be classified as.example: This material is classified as recyclable.
be classified as.exampleZh: 这种材料被归类为可回收材料。

have no choice.meaning: 别无选择；原文 had no choice
have no choice.example: The road was closed, so we had no choice but to turn back.
have no choice.exampleZh: 路封了，我们别无选择，只能返回。

allow … to ….meaning: 允许或使某人能够做某事；allow somebody to do
allow … to ….example: The app allows me to study anywhere.
allow … to ….exampleZh: 这个应用让我可以在任何地方学习。

health insurance.meaning: 医疗保险；为医疗费用提供保障的保险
health insurance.example: Her new job offers health insurance.
health insurance.exampleZh: 她的新工作提供医疗保险。

either … or ….meaning: 或者……或者……；连接两个可选项；原文指两条参保途径
either … or ….example: We can meet either today or tomorrow.
either … or ….exampleZh: 我们可以今天见面，也可以明天见面。

feel the need to.meaning: 觉得有必要做……；原文 have felt the need to
feel the need to.example: I felt the need to explain my decision.
feel the need to.exampleZh: 我觉得有必要解释我的决定。

no longer.meaning: 不再；过去的状态已经结束
no longer.example: I no longer work on Sundays.
no longer.exampleZh: 我不再在星期天工作了。

catch up.meaning: 跟上进度；赶上（catch up after 在……之后赶上）
catch up.example: She missed a week but caught up quickly.
catch up.exampleZh: 她缺了一周的课，但很快跟上了。

early exposure.meaning: 早期接触；较早的接触（exposure to sth）
early exposure.example: Early exposure to books helps children read.
early exposure.exampleZh: 早期接触书籍有助于孩子阅读。

not just ... but ....meaning: 不只是……而是……；用于纠正或强调
not just ... but ....example: The job is not just a salary but a chance to learn.
not just ... but ....exampleZh: 这份工作不只是薪水，还是学习的机会。

break down ... into ....meaning: 把……分解成……；原句 breaking down problems into bite-sized chunks
break down ... into ....example: Break the task down into three steps.
break down ... into ....exampleZh: 把这个任务分解成三步。

fill the gap.example: Free classes help fill the gap in training.
fill the gap.exampleZh: 免费课程有助于填补培训缺口。

packed to the brim.meaning: 装得满满当当；形容人满为患或安排很紧
packed to the brim.example: The hall was packed to the brim.

drive ... away.meaning: 把……赶走；使……退却；原句 drive the students away
drive ... away.example: Harsh comments can drive beginners away.
drive ... away.exampleZh: 严厉的评论会把初学者吓走。

gear ... toward ....meaning: 使……面向……；让……适应……；原句 gear lessons toward things they're interested in
gear ... toward ....example: The course is geared toward busy adults.
gear ... toward ....exampleZh: 这门课程面向忙碌的成年人。

for instance.example: Some apps, for instance, suggest music.
for instance.exampleZh: 比如，有些应用会推荐音乐。

drop out of.example: He dropped out of college after one year.
drop out of.exampleZh: 他上了一年就从大学退学了。

by the time.example: By the time you arrive, I will be ready.
by the time.exampleZh: 等你到的时候，我就准备好了。

apply to.meaning: 适用于；对……适用（不是“申请”）
apply to.exampleZh: 这条规则适用于所有人。

go into.meaning: 进入（某行业或领域）；从事
go into.example: She went into teaching after college.
go into.exampleZh: 她大学毕业后从事教学工作。

an army of.meaning: 一大批；一大群（比喻数量众多）
an army of.example: An army of fans waited outside.
an army of.exampleZh: 一大群粉丝在外面等候。

the rest of one's life.meaning: 某人的余生；剩下的生活
the rest of one's life.example: He plans to travel for the rest of his life.

coax ... into doing ....example: She coaxed him into trying again.

the more ..., the more ....meaning: 越……就越……；原句 the younger ..., the earlier ..., the better
the more ..., the more ....example: The more you read, the faster you read.
the more ..., the more ....exampleZh: 你读得越多，读得就越快。

as many as.meaning: 多达……；用在可数名词数量前，强调数量多
as many as.example: As many as fifty people came.

lend ... to ....meaning: 给……增添某种特点；原句lent red to the landscape，不是借钱
lend ... to ....example: The candles lend warmth to the room.
lend ... to ....exampleZh: 蜡烛给房间增添温馨感。

list ... as ....meaning: 把……列为……；原句list the bird as threatened
list ... as ....example: They listed the building as historic.
list ... as ....exampleZh: 他们把这栋建筑列为历史建筑。

push ... to do ....meaning: 敦促……做……；原句pushed the agency to designate
push ... to do ....example: They pushed the school to improve safety.
push ... to do ....exampleZh: 他们敦促学校改善安全措施。

crack down on.meaning: 严厉打击；采取强硬措施制止
crack down on.example: Police crack down on illegal sales.
crack down on.exampleZh: 警方严厉打击非法销售。

try out.meaning: 尝试使用；试验某种方法
try out.example: Let's try out the new app.
try out.exampleZh: 我们试试这个新应用吧。

in particular.meaning: 尤其；具体而言，用于突出特定事项
in particular.example: I like fruit, apples in particular.
in particular.exampleZh: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。

call for.meaning: 呼吁；要求；原句called for forging closer collaborations
call for.example: They called for better public transport.
call for.exampleZh: 他们呼吁改善公共交通。

as long as.meaning: 只要；引导条件，不是时间长度
as long as.example: You can stay as long as you are quiet.
as long as.exampleZh: 只要你保持安静，就可以留下。

require ... to do ....meaning: 要求……做……；原句requires individuals and businesses to pay
require ... to do ....example: The rule requires visitors to sign in.

replace ... with ....meaning: 用后者替换前者；原句replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres
replace ... with ....example: Replace the broken chair with a new one.
replace ... with ....exampleZh: 用一把新椅子替换坏椅子。

set aside.meaning: 预留；留出（本文留出土地作栖息地）
set aside.example: We set aside a room for study.
set aside.exampleZh: 我们留出一间房用于学习。

restore ... to ....meaning: 把……恢复到……；原句restoring populations to an annual average
restore ... to ....example: They restored the garden to its former beauty.
restore ... to ....exampleZh: 他们使花园恢复了往日的美丽。

in the driver's seat.meaning: 掌握主导权；处于控制地位
in the driver's seat.example: She is in the driver's seat on this project.
in the driver's seat.exampleZh: 她在这个项目中掌握主导权。

go too far.meaning: 做得过头；超过合理限度，不是走得太远
go too far.example: The new rule goes too far.
go too far.exampleZh: 这项新规定做得过头了。

not ... enough.meaning: 还不够……；原句doesn't go far enough表示力度不够
not ... enough.example: The room is not warm enough.

responsibility for.meaning: 对……的责任；后可接名词或动名词
responsibility for.example: She took responsibility for the error.
responsibility for.exampleZh: 她为这个错误承担责任。

give up.meaning: 放弃；停止某活动，原句Give up TV指不再看电视
give up.example: I gave up watching TV at night.

at all times.example: Keep your phone with you at all times.

in my experience.meaning: 按我的经验；根据个人经历提出看法
in my experience.example: In my experience, short breaks help.
in my experience.exampleZh: 按我的经验，短暂休息有帮助。

free up.example: The change freed up an hour.
free up.exampleZh: 这一改变腾出了一小时。

or else.meaning: 或者；要不然；本句引出另一种妨碍阅读的情况
or else.example: We walk to work, or else we take the bus.
or else.exampleZh: 我们步行上班，或者乘公交车。

the last thing you need.meaning: 你最不需要的东西或情况；并非清单上的最后一项
the last thing you need.example: More stress is the last thing you need.
the last thing you need.exampleZh: 你最不需要的就是更多压力。

be inclined to.meaning: 倾向于；易于（后可接不定式或名词）

think of ... as ....meaning: 把……看作……；原句Thinking of time as a resource
think of ... as ....example: We think of the library as a quiet refuge.
think of ... as ....exampleZh: 我们把图书馆看作安静的避风港。

in so far as.meaning: 就……程度而言；限于……范围，本句把推进目标作为衡量时间价值的条件
in so far as.example: The rule helps in so far as it reduces confusion.
in so far as.exampleZh: 这条规则在减少混乱的范围内有帮助。

by contrast.example: The first room is noisy; the second, by contrast, is quiet.
by contrast.exampleZh: 第一个房间很吵；相比之下，第二个很安静。

be willing to.meaning: 愿意做……；原句being willing to risk
be willing to.example: I am willing to try again.

slot ... in.meaning: 把某活动安排进时间表；原句slot it in
slot ... in.example: Can you slot a short walk in after lunch?
slot ... in.exampleZh: 你能在午饭后安排一次短暂散步吗？

lose yourself in.meaning: 沉浸于；全神贯注于，原句losing yourself in a book
lose yourself in.example: You can lose yourself in a good novel.
lose yourself in.exampleZh: 你可以沉浸在一本好小说中。

dip in.meaning: 间或翻阅；读一小部分，本文指经常短暂回到阅读
dip in.example: This guide is easy to dip in and out of.
dip in.exampleZh: 这本指南便于随时翻读一点。

take care of.meaning: 处理；照料，本文take care of business指处理事务
take care of.example: I will take care of the paperwork.
take care of.exampleZh: 我会处理这些文书工作。

as if.meaning: 好像；仿佛，引出感受或比较
as if.example: It feels as if spring has arrived.
as if.exampleZh: 感觉好像春天已经来了。

against a backdrop of.meaning: 在……背景下；原句Against a backdrop of drastic changes
against a backdrop of.example: The talks began against a backdrop of uncertainty.
against a backdrop of.exampleZh: 谈判在不确定的背景下开始。

in their sixties.meaning: 在他们六十多岁时；one's可随主语替换
in their sixties.example: My parents retired in their sixties.
in their sixties.exampleZh: 我父母六十多岁时退休。

agree on.meaning: 就某事达成一致；on后接讨论事项
agree on.example: We agree on the main goal.
agree on.exampleZh: 我们对主要目标达成一致。

get started in life.meaning: 开始人生的独立阶段；初步立业安身，原句getting started in life
get started in life.example: Young adults need support to get started in life.

be accustomed to.meaning: 习惯于；熟悉，to为介词，后接名词或动名词；本文are well accustomed to managing
be accustomed to.example: She is accustomed to walking daily.

serve as.example: The report serves as a guide.

complain of.meaning: 抱怨某种问题；本文complaining of是完成进行时中的形式
complain of.example: Residents complain of noise at night.

be unlikely to.meaning: 不太可能做某事；后接动词原形，本文为are unlikely to stop
be unlikely to.example: The problem is unlikely to disappear overnight.
be unlikely to.exampleZh: 这个问题不太可能一夜之间消失。

be hard on.meaning: 对……造成负担或伤害；本文is hard on指采收劳动对年长者身体负担重
be hard on.example: Long hours are hard on the body.
be hard on.exampleZh: 长时间工作对身体负担很重。

all along.example: She knew the answer all along.

as a result.meaning: 因此；结果，承接前述情况说明其后果
as a result.example: The road was closed. As a result, deliveries were late.
as a result.exampleZh: 道路关闭了。因此，送货延误了。

be reliant on.meaning: 依赖于；reliant后接on，本文have grown reliant表示已经变得依赖
be reliant on.example: The village is reliant on tourism.

even so.meaning: 即便如此；尽管前述情况成立，后述困难或反差仍存在
even so.example: The fee is low. Even so, few people apply.
even so.exampleZh: 费用很低。即便如此，申请的人仍很少。

lead ... to ....meaning: 使……做某事；第一个槽位为人或事物，to后接动词原形，本文led是过去式
lead ... to ....example: The delay led us to arrive late.

be short of.meaning: 缺少；不足，后接所缺的资源，本文were short of labor
be short of.example: The team is short of time.

a bunch of.meaning: 一群、一批；较口语，原句指一群名人。
a bunch of.example: A bunch of friends helped me move.

swap out.meaning: 换掉、替换；原句指换掉一次性塑料日用品。
swap out.example: You can swap out the old battery.

put together.meaning: 汇集、整理；原句have been put together表示信息已被整理到一起。
put together.example: She put together a short report.
put together.exampleZh: 她整理了一份简短的报告。

be directed at.meaning: 面向、以……为对象；原句is directed at说明信息主要面向个人。
be directed at.example: The advice is directed at new parents.
be directed at.exampleZh: 这些建议面向新手父母。

leave it up to.meaning: 把决定或任务交由某人处理；原句leaving it up to the individual指把环保行动交给个人。
leave it up to.example: We left it up to the team to decide.
leave it up to.exampleZh: 我们把决定交给团队作出。

do one's bit.meaning: 尽自己的一份力；原句have done our bit是觉得自己已经尽力了，one’s对应our。
do one's bit.example: Everyone can do their bit to help.
do one's bit.exampleZh: 每个人都可以尽自己的一份力来帮忙。

moral licensing.meaning: 道德许可；文中指因认为自己已经做了好事，便放松对后续行动的要求。
moral licensing.example: Moral licensing made him excuse wasting food after donating to charity.
moral licensing.exampleZh: 道德许可心理使他在捐款后为浪费食物找借口。

stop sb doing.meaning: 阻止或使某人停止做某事；sb为人称槽位，原句stops us doing … and asking …，原书未用from。
stop sb doing.example: The rain stopped us playing outside.
stop sb doing.exampleZh: 下雨使我们无法在外面玩耍。

in charge.meaning: 负责、掌权；原句those in charge指负责或掌权的人。

hold ... to account.meaning: 要求……对行为负责、向……问责；省略槽位为被问责的人或机构。
hold ... to account.example: Voters can hold officials to account.

push for.meaning: 推动、争取；原句to push for change与pushing for change均指争取变革。
push for.example: Residents are pushing for safer streets.
push for.exampleZh: 居民正在争取更安全的街道。

care about.meaning: 关心、在意；原句caring about the environment对应care的动名词。

too ... for ... to ....meaning: 太……而使……不能或不足以……；原句个人行动too slow，无法作为唯一乃至主要途径；for后接不定式的逻辑主语。
too ... for ... to ....example: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
too ... for ... to ....exampleZh: 这个箱子太重，我搬不动。

write off.meaning: 认为无用、否定价值或不再重视；原句writing off the individual是否定个人作用，不是账款核销。

put ... into perspective.meaning: 联系整体情况，恰当地看待事物的重要性与关系；原句putting things into perspective中things占据宾语槽位。
put ... into perspective.example: The wider context puts the result into perspective.
put ... into perspective.exampleZh: 更广泛的背景使我们能够恰当地看待这一结果。

be attuned to.meaning: 对……敏感；能注意并适应相关信号。
be attuned to.example: A good listener is attuned to changes in tone.
be attuned to.exampleZh: 善于倾听的人对语气变化很敏感。

find out.meaning: 弄清、查明信息；find out if/whether引出是否。
find out.example: I want to find out when the shop opens.
find out.exampleZh: 我想弄清商店什么时候开门。

follow ... around.meaning: 跟着……四处走；原句为followed the living rats around。
follow ... around.exampleZh: 这只小狗总是跟着我四处走。

side to side.meaning: 左右来回；从一侧到另一侧。
side to side.example: Move your head gently from side to side.

on average.meaning: 平均而言；就总体平均水平来说。
on average.example: The trip takes an hour on average.
on average.exampleZh: 这趟行程平均需要一个小时。

set ... free.example: They set the trapped bird free.
set ... free.exampleZh: 他们释放了被困的小鸟。

perceive ... as ....example: She perceived the change as an opportunity.
perceive ... as ....exampleZh: 她把这项变化视为一个机会。

bond with.example: The new teacher bonded with the class.
bond with.exampleZh: 新老师与班级建立了亲密联系。

return the favour.meaning: 回报好意；对曾帮助自己的人予以帮助。
return the favour.example: She lent me a book, and I returned the favour later.
return the favour.exampleZh: 她借给我一本书，后来我回报了她的好意。

engage in.meaning: 参与、从事某种活动；in后接名词或动名词。

be referred to as.meaning: 被称为……；原句is referred to as。
be referred to as.example: This approach is referred to as teamwork.
be referred to as.exampleZh: 这种方法被称为团队合作。

the same ... as.meaning: 与……相同；原句为the same size as。
the same ... as.example: My bag is the same color as yours.
the same ... as.exampleZh: 我的包和你的颜色相同。

have to.meaning: 必须、不得不做某事；后接动词原形。
have to.example: I have to leave before six.
have to.exampleZh: 我必须在六点之前离开。

turn out.meaning: 结果是；事实证明，原句it turns out后接从句。
turn out.example: It turned out that the shop was closed.

go up.meaning: 上涨、增加；本文gone up为完成时形式。
go up.example: The price has gone up again.

up one's game.meaning: 提升自己的水平或表现；原句have upped their game。
up one's game.example: She practised daily to up her game.
up one's game.exampleZh: 她每天练习，以提升自己的表现。

relative to.meaning: 相较于、相对于；限定比较的参照对象。
relative to.example: The cost is small relative to the benefit.
relative to.exampleZh: 相较于收益，这项成本很小。

a sense of.meaning: 对……的理解或判断力；本文指金融市场，并非只表示感官。
a sense of.example: She has a good sense of what customers need.

public relations.meaning: 公共关系、公关；与公众沟通并维护形象的活动。
public relations.example: The firm needs better public relations.
public relations.exampleZh: 这家公司需要更好的公关。

supply chain.meaning: 供应链；生产与配送中的企业或环节网络，原句为复数。
supply chain.example: The factory improved its supply chain.
supply chain.exampleZh: 这家工厂改善了供应链。

research and development.example: The firm invests in research and development.

rip ... off.meaning: 敲诈、剥削或宰客；原句ripping people off。
rip ... off.example: The seller ripped me off with an unfair price.
rip ... off.exampleZh: 这个卖家用不合理的价格宰了我。

corporate governance.meaning: 公司治理；企业管理、监督和决策的机制。
corporate governance.exampleZh: 明确的规定能够改善公司治理。

in ... interest.meaning: 符合……的利益；原句in the broader corporate interest。
in ... interest.example: It is in everyone's interest to reduce waste.
in ... interest.exampleZh: 减少浪费符合每个人的利益。

tie ... to ....meaning: 把……与……联系或挂钩；原句tie CEO pay to stock prices。
tie ... to ....example: The school ties rewards to effort.
tie ... to ....exampleZh: 学校把奖励与努力挂钩。

build up.meaning: 逐渐增加、积累；本文增加公司价值。
build up.exampleZh: 经常练习能够逐渐增强信心。

be hailed as.example: The town was hailed as a model of clean transport.
be hailed as.exampleZh: 这个城镇被誉为清洁交通的典范。

roll out.meaning: 正式推出（措施、服务等）；原句rolled out
roll out.example: The school rolled out a new course.
roll out.exampleZh: 学校推出了一门新课程。

at best.meaning: 即使按最有利的情况；最乐观地说
at best.example: At best, the repairs will take a week.
at best.exampleZh: 即使按最有利情况，修缮也要一周。

back and forth.meaning: 来回反复；可指讨论或政策反复
back and forth.example: The back and forth delayed the project.

on their own.meaning: 独自；不依靠他人，their按句回指主体
on their own.example: They solved the problem on their own.

far from it.meaning: 恰恰相反；完全不是那样，用来否定前述说法
far from it.example: Was the trip boring? Far from it.
far from it.exampleZh: 旅行很无聊吗？恰恰相反。

in the face of.example: She stayed calm in the face of danger.
in the face of.exampleZh: 面对危险，她保持了冷静。

can only do so much.example: One teacher can only do so much.
can only do so much.exampleZh: 一位老师能做的终究有限。

keep ... out of.meaning: 不让……进入……；原句keep ... cars out of ... areas
keep ... out of.example: The fence keeps animals out of the garden.
keep ... out of.exampleZh: 围栏不让动物进入花园。

bring ... into compliance.meaning: 使……符合规定；原句bring their vehicles into compliance
bring ... into compliance.example: The repairs brought the building into compliance.
bring ... into compliance.exampleZh: 修缮使建筑达到了合规要求。

clean up.meaning: 整治；清除污染或不良问题，本文指整治汽车排放
clean up.example: The factory must clean up its operations.
clean up.exampleZh: 工厂必须整治生产活动中的污染问题。

give or take.meaning: 上下相差；前后浮动（若干数量）
give or take.example: It takes an hour, give or take ten minutes.
give or take.exampleZh: 需要一小时，前后相差十分钟。

be about to.meaning: 即将做……；原句are about to hit

look for.example: She is looking for a stable job.
look for.exampleZh: 她正在寻找一份稳定的工作。

plan on.meaning: 计划做……，on后接名词或动名词；原句planning on hiring
plan on.example: We plan on travelling next month.

according to.example: According to the survey, most people agreed.
according to.exampleZh: 调查显示，大多数人同意。

take chances.meaning: 冒险；原句taking any chances，any位于否定范围
take chances.example: We cannot take chances with safety.
take chances.exampleZh: 安全问题上我们不能冒险。

with ... in mind.meaning: 考虑到……；原句with a job in mind
with ... in mind.example: Choose a course with your goals in mind.
with ... in mind.exampleZh: 选择课程时要考虑你的目标。

be dedicated to.meaning: 致力于……；to后接名词或动名词，原句being dedicated to a cause
be dedicated to.example: She is dedicated to helping children.

the greater good.example: They work for the greater good.

gig economy.meaning: 零工经济；以短期、临时或零散工作为特点的经济形态
gig economy.example: The gig economy offers flexible work.
gig economy.exampleZh: 零工经济提供灵活的工作。

have trouble doing.meaning: 做……有困难；原句have trouble seeing
